name: booking-hand
prompt: Create a NEW original editorial illustration for the MOBILE edition of Brazilian barbershop software NaRégua. Image 1 is the exact official brand identity reference, never invent a replacement logo. Image 2 is the REAL booking interface: use its petroleum, ivory, copper, typography, official N mark and booking structure on the phone screen; do not invent unrelated SaaS branding. Image 3 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: study the fine dark ink contour, crosshatching, warm watercolor skin, cut-paper editorial quality. IGNORE its green palette and avocado subject completely. Deliver ONE isolated vertical 3:4 transparent-background composition, not a website, not text around the artwork. A naturally drawn adult barber's warm brown LEFT hand enters from bottom-left and holds a slim realistic silver smartphone almost front-on, tilted just 5 degrees clockwise. Phone fills 65 percent of the asset width, screen large and crisp, recognizable real booking reference. At lower right, a separate naturally drawn right hand in a petroleum work-shirt cuff holds a vintage chrome hair clipper with restrained copper details. Only TWO hands, anatomically correct, five fingers each, credible grips, no overlapping impossible joints. Phone and clipper form one compact upward composition appropriate for a 350px-wide mobile landing; wrists intentionally exit bottom edge, leave clean air above the objects. Fine visible hatch lines, hand-painted gouache/watercolor, restrained shadows, sophisticated illustrated barber craft. Petroleum #082a39, copper #b85a30, ivory #fffdf8, warm skin and chrome only. NO green, lime, avocado, gradients, neon, glossy plastic skin, 3D resin, sculptures, floating UI cards, dashboards or decorative ribbons. Native transparent alpha around all artwork.

name: team-handoff
prompt: Create one NEW original editorial ink-and-watercolor illustration for the MOBILE edition of NaRégua, about a barbershop team working in rhythm. Image 1 defines the existing brand palette petroleum, copper and warm ivory, do not redraw its logo. Image 2 provides product context only, no screen needed. Deliver isolated landscape 3:2 composition with native transparent alpha, not a website. Two naturally drawn adult hands enter from opposite bottom corners: one hand in a petroleum barber work-shirt cuff passes a pair of elegant chrome barber scissors by the safe handle toward the other open receiving hand in a copper cuff. Scissor blades point safely upward away from palms. A slim ivory comb lies horizontally below as a subtle baseline, not floating confetti. Deliberate gesture, credible fingers, FIVE fingers each, natural joints. This is a small editorial gesture that will read beautifully at 320 CSS pixels, not an overloaded scene. Beautiful engraved linework and restrained warm gouache, ink edges clean, understated shadow, only petroleum #082a39, copper #b85a30, ivory, chrome and natural warm skin. No green, neon, avocado, resin, marble busts, abstract ribbons, extra hands, phones or any text.
